usage: notebooklm-health.py [-h] [--codex-config CODEX_CONFIG]
                            [--tools-exposed] [--notebook-url NOTEBOOK_URL]
                            [--write] [--format {md,json}]
                            [config]

positional arguments:
  config                Path to seo-cycle.yaml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --codex-config CODEX_CONFIG
                        Codex TOML config to inspect for NotebookLM MCP.
  --tools-exposed       Mark NotebookLM MCP tools as visible in the current
                        session.
  --notebook-url NOTEBOOK_URL
                        NotebookLM SEO notebook URL.
  --write               Write seo/setup/notebooklm-health.* artifacts.
  --format {md,json}
